facts.text: The user asks whether all the equations in their model are included.
The user asks to print the meaning of every symbol used in their equations.
The user defines fossil energy price in one period as pf.
The user states that fossil energy price pf is lower than green energy price pg in the same period.
The user defines returns on investment on green energy as re.
The user states that returns on investment on green energy re are higher than returns on investment for fossil energy rf.
The user defines returns on investment in other sectors of the economy as ro.
The user states that returns on investment on green energy re are lower than the return on investment in other sectors ro.
The user defines the economy growth rate as G = go + gg + gf.
The user defines gg as the growth rate for green energy.
The user defines gf as the growth rate for fossil energy.
The user defines go as the growth rate for all the other sectors in the economy.
The user states that gg is greater than gf.
The user asks whether the economy will ever reach a stable point using the equations in their model.
The user asks to answer with equations in their model using letters as constants whenever necessary.
The user asks what changes to make to their model so energy prices are a function of labor, capital, and demand.

keyphrases: energy prices as function of labor capital demand
